thread:
Samir Patel: FYI opened a docs PR to tighten SOC2 wording and add an "audit logs & retention" section. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842

Ellen W.: Nice. Can we avoid first-person phrasing? legal prefers 'customers may configure' vs 'we retain'.

Priya Rao: Will update. Also planning to include a JS SDK snippet to fetch audit exports and a curl example for SRE smoke tests.

Marcus Li: Heads-up: API path changed in prod last week -> /v1/admin/audit-logs (was /v1/auditlogs). Update examples and link to the published schema.

Samir Patel: Good catch, Marcus. I swapped the paths and added a migration checklist for Dedicated customers (check endpoints, webhooks, rotate API keys).

Priya Rao: Draft SDK snippet to include in PR:
```js
// list audit logs (admin)
await client.admin.auditLogs.list({ start_time: '2025-02-01T00:00:00Z', limit: 200 });
// admins can update retention via PATCH /v1/admin/retention
```
I'll add that to the PR under Examples.

Ellen W.: Small wording change: instead of "admins can update retention", use "admins can configure retention; legal or regulatory obligations may require different retention periods."

Samir Patel: Updated copy in PR. Also replaced internal SOC2 mapping link with the public PDF: https://redwood-inference.com/compliance/soc2-mapping.pdf

Marcus Li: Please include a one-line curl so we can smoke-test the endpoint in staging: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/admin/audit-logs?page=1"`

Priya Rao: Added the curl and a tiny table example mapping audit event names to SOC2 categories (access, modification, deletion). Keeps it concrete for customers.

security-review-bot: Automated lint: docs/code-block-language-missing on one code block. Also flagged phrase "we keep logs" -> recommend neutral/configurable phrasing.

Samir Patel: Fixed code block languages and replaced the flagged phrasing. Marked PR ready-for-review.

Ellen W.: I'll take a legal pre-review tomorrow morning and then loop in compliance. If small we can ship as a docs-only minor release.

Priya Rao: After Ellen's pass I'll sync with Legal and post a short release note. Also adding a quick migration checklist for Dedicated customers at the top of the doc.

Marcus Li: Backend will validate the endpoint in staging once merged. If any webhook URLs change, please list the steps to rotate keys in the migration checklist.

Samir Patel: Done. Assigning to @Ellen W. for review. :white_check_mark:
